sloka: अथ पवन समान विक्रमाःप्लवग वराः प्रतिलब्ध पौरुषाः ।अभिजित् अभिमुखाम् दिशम् ययुःजनक सुता परिमार्गण उन्मुखाः ॥४-६३-१५॥
transliteration: atha pavana samāna vikramāḥplavaga varāḥ pratilabdha pauruṣāḥ ।abhijit abhimukhām diśam yayuḥjanaka sutā parimārgaṇa unmukhāḥ ॥4-63-15॥

translations.english: The monkeys as strong as the wind regained courage and went in search of the daughter of Janaka in the direction of Abhijit (constellation known as Abhijit is associated with success). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtythird sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
